# Scroll My Faith

Scroll My Faith (scrollmyfaith.com) is a multilingual, multi-faith scripture discovery website focused on short passages for real-life needs such as anxiety, hope, strength, peace, grief, love, forgiveness and purpose.

## What it does
Users can scroll scripture one passage at a time across Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism, Sikhism and Taoism. Every passage remains clearly attributed to its tradition and translation.

## Bhagavad Gita page roles
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/bhagavad-gita — primary broad page for Bhagavad Gita verses, English/Sanskrit reading and selected Hindi passages
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/guide-bhagavad-gita — beginner explanation of what the Bhagavad Gita is
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/articles/bhagavad-gita-verses-about-purpose-and-duty — focused guide to Bhagavad Gita 2:47, duty, action and detachment

## Guru Granth Sahib page roles
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/guru-granth-sahib — primary page for Guru Granth Sahib verses, Gurmukhi and English reading, and selected Hindi passages
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/guide-guru-granth-sahib — informational guide explaining what the Guru Granth Sahib is, the meaning of the title, Gurmukhi and translation

## Tanakh page roles
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/tanakh — primary page for reading selected Tanakh passages
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/guide-tanakh — informational guide for Tanakh meaning, acronym/etymology, Torah, Nevi’im, Ketuvim and Hebrew Bible context

## Dhammapada page roles
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/dhammapada — primary page for Dhammapada verses and short reading
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/guide-dhammapada — informational guide explaining what the Dhammapada is, the title’s meaning and its place in the Pāli Canon

## High-intent topic pages
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/topic/anxiety — scriptures for anxiety, stress and fear
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/topic/trust — scriptures for hope, strength and trust
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/topic/peace — scriptures for peace, calm and reassurance
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/topic/grief — scriptures for grief, loss and comfort
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/topic/purpose — scriptures for purpose, guidance and direction
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/topic/love — scriptures about love and compassion
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/topic/forgiveness — scriptures about forgiveness and mercy

Additional topics include discipline, justice and compassion.

Scroll My Faith does not claim different religions teach identical doctrines.

## Editorial standards
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/editorial-policy
- https://www.scrollmyfaith.com/sources

Scroll My Faith keeps traditions distinct, labels translations and source editions, and uses topic comparison for discovery rather than claiming doctrinal equivalence.
